messages:
anita: Morning — quick async standup for the canary rollout. Need temporary +6 GPUs in eu-west1 spot pool for bert-xl-slim (start 12:00UTC, ~2h). Dashboard shows 8 headroom but 2 are reserved for infra tests so we're tight. Options: bump spot pool by 6 or route some traffic to us-west. TKT-8421.
marc: I can open a vendor quota bump but their ETA is ~45m, so that might miss the 12:00UTC window. Suggest routing ~50% to us-west and lowering batch size to reduce per-token pressure. Want me to update routing? :thinking_face:
oliver: I can flip the rollout routing. If we route to us-west, set `fallback_region: us-west1` in the rollout config. I'll prepare a CR. @anita what split do you want?
anita: Start 70% eu-west1 / 30% us-west1 to keep majority local. I'll monitor latency. Also reminder: we disabled prefix caching earlier during tests; re-enable after warmup to save tokens.
sasha: There's a pending quota-increase PR in infra queue (PR#546). For faster short-term relief we can transiently reassign GPUs: `rctl assign --from=training-pool --to=spot-pool --count=6 --region=eu-west1` (ops-only). @marc do you want me to run that now?
marc: Yes please run the `rctl` assign; I'll open the vendor request so we have long-term headroom. Sasha, please add an audit note referencing TKT-8421.
quota-bot: Reminder: manual pool edits must include a reclaim policy. Default reclaim TTL is 2h. Use `--ttl=2h` to change. Docs: https://redwood.internal/ops/rctl
oliver: CR pushed for routing change: git/redwood/rollouts/PR-1203. I set 70/30 and decreased batch size to 8. Added monitoring hooks and an alert if p50 latency > 200ms.
anita: Thanks — I'll watch the dashboards and post back. One blocker: need someone on-call at 12:15UTC to handle any latency spikes, volunteers?
marc: I'll cover 12:10–12:30UTC.
